description: Teardrops on My Guitar — my very first taste of people actually connecting to my songs. I was 16 and writing about a boy named Drew who had no idea I existed romantically. It's so unguarded it almost makes me cringe now, but it's also the song that taught me I could reach people. I can't give my sixteen-year-old self less than five stars, she was doing her best 🥹🫶
